story: Stage 16 unfolded with a 17-man breakaway establishing itself after 50 km of racing. Around 60 km from the finish, Mikel Landa attacked, sparking a lead group of five. One by one riders dropped until only Bernal and Landa remained. Due to protests, the finish was moved 8 km earlier, where Bernal outsprinted Landa for victory.
